title.en: Shop assistant: from listing to your first customer
title.af: Winkelassistent: van advertensie tot jou eerste kliënt
title.zu: Umsizi wasesitolo: kusukela esikhangisweni kuya ekhasimendeni lakho lokuqala
title.xh: Umncedisi wevenkile: ukusuka kwintengiso ukuya kumthengi wakho wokuqala
title.nso: Mothuši wa lebenkeleng: go tloga papatšong go ya go moreki wa gago wa mathomo

gate_note.en: Coming up at step 10: until someone you worked for confirms you, only people you send your link to can see your listing.
gate_note.af: By stap 10: totdat iemand vir wie jy gewerk het jou bevestig, kan net mense aan wie jy jou skakel stuur jou advertensie sien.
gate_note.zu: Kuyeza esinyathelweni 10: kuze kube yilapho umuntu owake wamsebenzela ekuqinisekisa, ngabantu kuphela obathumelela isixhumanisi sakho abangabona isikhangiso sakho.
gate_note.xh: Kwinyathelo le-10: de kube umntu owakhe wamsebenzela akuqinisekise, ngabantu kuphela obathumelela ikhonkco lakho abanokubona intengiso yakho.
gate_note.nso: Kgatong ya 10: go fihlela motho yo o kilego wa mo šomela a go netefatša, ke batho feela bao o ba romelago kgokagano ya gago bao ba ka bonago papatšo ya gago.

chapters.en: Open the door to new customers
chapters.af: Maak die deur oop vir nuwe kliënte

chapters.nso: Bareki ba gago ba ka mehla

en: Open Quick, tap [[Offer a service]]
Quick opens on the services door. One tap starts your listing.
af: Maak Quick oop, tik [[Offer a service]]
Quick maak oop by die dienste-deur. Een tik begin jou advertensie.
zu: Vula i-Quick, thepha [[Offer a service]]
I-Quick ivula emnyango wezinsizakalo. Ukuthepha kanye kuqala isikhangiso sakho.
xh: Vula i-Quick, cofa [[Offer a service]]
I-Quick ivula kucango leenkonzo. Ukucofa kanye kuqalisa intengiso yakho.
nso: Bula Quick, kgotla [[Offer a service]]
Quick e bula lebating la ditirelo. Go kgotla gatee go thoma papatšo ya gago.

en: Pick [[Shops & forecourt]], then [[Shop assistant]]
Choose the kind of work, then your job.
af: Kies [[Shops & forecourt]], dan [[Shop assistant]]
Kies die soort werk, dan jou werk.
zu: Khetha [[Shops & forecourt]], bese [[Shop assistant]]
Khetha uhlobo lomsebenzi, bese kuba umsebenzi wakho.
xh: Khetha [[Shops & forecourt]], emva koko [[Shop assistant]]
Khetha uhlobo lomsebenzi, emva koko umsebenzi wakho.
nso: Kgetha [[Shops & forecourt]], ke moka [[Shop assistant]]
Kgetha mohuta wa mošomo, ke moka mošomo wa gago.

en: Tick every area you work in
You can tick more than one, and a customer searching any of them finds you. Type your area if it is not listed.
af: Merk elke area waar jy werk
Jy kan meer as een merk, en 'n kliënt wat in enige van hulle soek, vind jou. Tik jou area in as dit nie gelys is nie.
zu: Maka zonke izindawo osebenza kuzo
Ungamaka ezingaphezu kweyodwa, futhi ikhasimende elisesha kunoma iyiphi yazo liyakuthola. Bhala indawo yakho uma ingekho ohlwini.
xh: Phawula yonke imimandla osebenza kuyo
Ungaphawula engaphezu komnye, kwaye umthengi okhangela kuyo nayiphi na uyakufumana. Bhala indawo yakho ukuba ayikho kuluhlu.
nso: Swaya mafelo ka moka ao o šomago go ona
O ka swaya a fetago le tee, gomme moreki yo a nyakago go le ge e le lefe la ona o a go hwetša. Ngwala lefelo la gago ge le se lenaneong.

en: Choose your days
Tap the days you can work.
af: Kies jou dae
Tik die dae waarop jy kan werk.
zu: Khetha izinsuku zakho
Thepha izinsuku ongasebenza ngazo.
xh: Khetha iintsuku zakho
Cofa iintsuku onokusebenza ngazo.
nso: Kgetha matšatši a gago
Kgotla matšatši ao o ka šomago ka ona.

en: Set your day rate
Type what your work is worth. Quick shows the legal minimum wage, so nobody can pay you less.
af: Stel jou dagtarief
Tik wat jou werk werd is. Quick wys die wetlike minimum loon, sodat niemand jou minder kan betaal nie.
zu: Beka inani lakho losuku
Bhala ukuthi umsebenzi wakho ubiza malini. I-Quick ikhombisa iholo elincane elisemthethweni, ukuze kungabikho muntu okukhokhela ngaphansi kwalo.
xh: Beka ixabiso lakho losuku
Bhala ukuba umsebenzi wakho uxabisa malini. I-Quick ibonisa umvuzo omncinci osemthethweni, ukuze kungabikho mntu ukuhlawula ngaphantsi kwawo.
nso: Bea tefo ya gago ya letšatši
Ngwala gore mošomo wa gago o ja bokae. Quick e bontšha moputso wa fase wa semolao, gore go se be le yo a go lefago ka fase ga wona.

en: Add your first name and email, then save
No password. Your listing is saved, but nobody can see it yet.
af: Gee jou voornaam en e-posadres, en stoor
Geen wagwoord nie. Jou advertensie is gestoor, maar niemand kan dit nog sien nie.
zu: Faka igama lakho lokuqala ne-imeyili, bese ulondoloza
Akukho phasiwedi. Isikhangiso sakho silondoloziwe, kodwa akekho ongasibona okwamanje.
xh: Faka igama lakho lokuqala ne-imeyile, uze ugcine
Akukho phasiwedi. Intengiso yakho igciniwe, kodwa akukho mntu unokuyibona okwangoku.
nso: Tsenya leina la gago la mathomo le imeile, ke moka o boloke
Ga go phasewete. Papatšo ya gago e bolokilwe, eupša ga go yo a ka e bonago ga bjale.

en: Open the email, tap [[Open my listing]]
It signs you in on your phone and opens your draft in TrustSquare.
af: Maak die e-pos oop, tik [[Open my listing]]
Dit teken jou op jou foon in en maak jou konsep in TrustSquare oop.
zu: Vula i-imeyili, thepha [[Open my listing]]
Ikungenisa ocingweni lwakho futhi ivule uhlaka lwakho ku-TrustSquare.
xh: Vula i-imeyile, cofa [[Open my listing]]
Ikungenisa kwifowuni yakho kwaye ivule idrafti yakho kwi-TrustSquare.
nso: Bula imeile, kgotla [[Open my listing]]
E go tsenya mogaleng wa gago gomme e bula papatšo ya gago ya kakanyo go TrustSquare.

en: Add your own photo and sign the terms
Tap [[Edit]], add a photo of your work with no writing on it, and save. Read and accept the seller terms once.
af: Voeg jou eie foto by en teken die terme
Tik [[Edit]], voeg 'n foto van jou werk by sonder skrif daarop, en stoor. Lees en aanvaar die verkopersterme een keer.
zu: Faka isithombe sakho futhi usayine imigomo
Thepha [[Edit]], faka isithombe somsebenzi wakho esingenakho ukubhala, bese ulondoloza. Funda futhi wamukele imigomo yomthengisi kanye.
xh: Faka eyakho ifoto kwaye utyikitye imiqathango
Cofa [[Edit]], faka ifoto yomsebenzi wakho engenambhalo, uze ugcine. Funda kwaye wamkele imiqathango yomthengisi kube kanye.
nso: Tsenya seswantšho sa gago o saene mabaka
Kgotla [[Edit]], tsenya seswantšho sa mošomo wa gago se se se nago mongwalo, o boloke. Bala o amogele mabaka a morekiši gatee.

en: Publish
Your listing is live. For now only people you send your link to can see it. That keeps you safe.
af: Publiseer
Jou advertensie is lewendig. Vir eers kan net mense aan wie jy jou skakel stuur dit sien. Dit hou jou veilig.
zu: Shicilela
Isikhangiso sakho sesiphilayo. Okwamanje ngabantu kuphela obathumelela isixhumanisi sakho abangasibona. Lokho kukugcina uphephile.
xh: Papasha
Intengiso yakho iphilile. Okwangoku ngabantu kuphela obathumelela ikhonkco lakho abanokuyibona. Oko kukugcina ukhuselekile.
nso: Phatlalatša
Papatšo ya gago e a phela. Ga bjale ke batho feela bao o ba romelago kgokagano ya gago bao ba ka e bonago. Seo se go boloka o bolokegile.

en: Someone you worked for taps [[Yes]]
Tap [[Get my link for someone I worked for]] and send it. They confirm with one tap and a code by email. New customers can find you from then on, and your Trust Score goes up.
af: Iemand vir wie jy gewerk het, tik [[Yes]]
Tik [[Get my link for someone I worked for]] en stuur dit. Hulle bevestig met een tik en 'n kode per e-pos. Van dan af kan nuwe kliënte jou vind, en jou Trust Score gaan op.
zu: Umuntu owake wamsebenzela uthepha [[Yes]]

Thepha [[Get my link for someone I worked for]] bese uyasithumela. Baqinisekisa ngokuthepha kanye nangekhodi nge-imeyili. Kusukela lapho amakhasimende amasha angakuthola, futhi i-Trust Score yakho iyakhuphuka.
xh: Umntu owakhe wamsebenzela ucofa [[Yes]]

Cofa [[Get my link for someone I worked for]] uze ulithumele. Bayaqinisekisa ngokucofa kanye nangekhowudi nge-imeyile. Ukususela ngoko abathengi abatsha banokukufumana, kwaye i-Trust Score yakho iyanyuka.
nso: Motho yo o kilego wa mo šomela o kgotla [[Yes]]
Kgotla [[Get my link for someone I worked for]] o e romele. Ba netefatša ka go kgotla gatee le khoutu ka imeile. Go tloga fao bareki ba bafsa ba ka go hwetša, gomme Trust Score ya gago e a hlatloga.

en: Send your Buzz link to your regulars
In [[My Space]], open [[Buzz]] and tap [[Get my link]]. One link for all your regular customers, by [[WhatsApp]] or [[Copy]].
af: Stuur jou Buzz-skakel aan jou vaste kliënte
Maak [[Buzz]] in [[My Space]] oop en tik [[Get my link]]. Een skakel vir al jou vaste kliënte, per [[WhatsApp]] of [[Copy]].
zu: Thumela isixhumanisi sakho se-Buzz kumakhasimende akho ajwayelekile
Ku-[[My Space]], vula i-[[Buzz]] bese uthepha [[Get my link]]. Isixhumanisi esisodwa sawo wonke amakhasimende akho ajwayelekile, nge-[[WhatsApp]] noma [[Copy]].
xh: Thumela ikhonkco lakho le-Buzz kubathengi bakho abaqhelekileyo
Kwi-[[My Space]], vula i-[[Buzz]] uze ucofe [[Get my link]]. Ikhonkco elinye labo bonke abathengi bakho abaqhelekileyo, nge-[[WhatsApp]] okanye [[Copy]].
nso: Romela kgokagano ya gago ya Buzz go bareki ba gago ba ka mehla
Go [[My Space]], bula [[Buzz]] o kgotle [[Get my link]]. Kgokagano e tee ya bareki ba gago ka moka ba ka mehla, ka [[WhatsApp]] goba [[Copy]].

en: Your regular joins
They tap the link, accept the Buzz terms and sign in with a code. You are connected, and it costs nothing.
af: Jou vaste kliënt sluit aan
Hulle tik die skakel, aanvaar die Buzz-terme en teken met 'n kode in. Julle is verbind, en dit kos niks.
zu: Ikhasimende lakho elijwayelekile liyajoyina
Bathepha isixhumanisi, bamukele imigomo ye-Buzz bese bengena ngekhodi. Nixhumene, futhi akubizi lutho.
xh: Umthengi wakho oqhelekileyo uyajoyina
Bacofa ikhonkco, bamkele imiqathango ye-Buzz baze bangene ngekhowudi. Niqhagamshelene, kwaye akubizi nto.
nso: Moreki wa gago wa ka mehla o a tsena
Ba kgotla kgokagano, ba amogela mabaka a Buzz gomme ba tsena ka khoutu. Le kgokagane, gomme ga go bitše selo.

en: Buzz a regular
One line, straight to their phone, with your name on it.
af: Buzz 'n vaste kliënt
Een reël, reguit na hulle foon, met jou naam daarop.
zu: Buzz ikhasimende elijwayelekile
Umugqa owodwa, uqonde ocingweni lwabo, unegama lakho.
xh: Buzz umthengi oqhelekileyo
Umgca omnye, ngqo kwifowuni yakhe, unegama lakho.
nso: Buzz moreki wa ka mehla
Mothalo o tee, thwii mogaleng wa gagwe, o na le leina la gago.

en: A new customer finds you
She finds you under [[Services]] by area, and sees your rate, your days and your Trust Score.
af: 'n Nuwe kliënt vind jou
Sy vind jou onder [[Services]] volgens area, en sien jou tarief, jou dae en jou Trust Score.
zu: Ikhasimende elisha liyakuthola
Ukuthola ngaphansi kwe-[[Services]] ngendawo, abone inani lakho, izinsuku zakho ne-Trust Score yakho.
xh: Umthengi omtsha uyakufumana
Ukufumana phantsi kwe-[[Services]] ngendawo, abone ixabiso lakho, iintsuku zakho kunye ne-Trust Score yakho.
nso: Moreki yo moswa o a go hwetša
O go hwetša ka fase ga [[Services]] go ya ka lefelo, a bona tefo ya gago, matšatši a gago le Trust Score ya gago.

en: She asks for an introduction
She writes a short message. 1 Tuppence is held from her, and spent only if you accept.
af: Sy vra vir 'n bekendstelling
Sy skryf 'n kort boodskap. 1 Tuppence word van haar gehou, en net gebruik as jy aanvaar.
zu: Ucela ukwethulwa
Ubhala umlayezo omfushane. I-Tuppence engu-1 iyabanjwa kuye, isetshenziswe kuphela uma wamukela.
xh: Ucela ukwaziswa
Ubhala umyalezo omfutshane. I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa kuye, isetyenziswe kuphela ukuba uyamkela.
nso: O kgopela go tsebišwa
O ngwala molaetša o mokopana. Tuppence e 1 e swarwa go yena, gomme e šomišwa feela ge o amogela.

en: You accept
Open [[My Space]], then [[Intros]], and tap [[Accept]]. You both get an email: reply to it to talk. Your email address stays private.
af: Jy aanvaar
Maak [[My Space]] oop, dan [[Intros]], en tik [[Accept]]. Julle kry albei 'n e-pos: antwoord daarop om te praat. Jou e-posadres bly privaat.
zu: Uyamukela
Vula i-[[My Space]], bese [[Intros]], bese uthepha [[Accept]]. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili: phendula kuyo ukuze nikhulume. Ikheli lakho le-imeyili lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Uyamkela
Vula i-[[My Space]], emva koko [[Intros]], uze ucofe [[Accept]]. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile: phendula kuyo ukuze nithethe. Idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: O a amogela
Bula [[My Space]], ke moka [[Intros]], o kgotle [[Accept]]. Le hwetša imeile ka bobedi: e arabe gore le boledišane. Aterese ya gago ya imeile e dula e le sephiri.

en: Pass Quick on
Tap [[Pass Quick on to someone]] and share it with a friend who works like you.
af: Gee Quick aan
Tik [[Pass Quick on to someone]] en deel dit met 'n vriendin wat werk soos jy.
zu: Dlulisela i-Quick
Thepha [[Pass Quick on to someone]] bese uyabelana ngayo nomngane osebenza njengawe.
xh: Dlulisela i-Quick
Cofa [[Pass Quick on to someone]] uze wabelane ngayo nomhlobo osebenza njengawe.
nso: Fetišetša Quick pele
Kgotla [[Pass Quick on to someone]] o e abelane le mogwera yo a šomago bjalo ka wena.
